canonical_title: A Case Study of the Indoor Performance of Bluetooth Smart with Raspberry Pi
aliases: A Case Study of the Indoor Performance of Bluetooth Smart with Raspberry Pi 3
advisor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
abstract: This project deals with the results of an experimental study of the indoor transmission performance of Bluetooth low energy (BLE, also known as Bluetooth Smart) using Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi Zero W. The l2ping link layer tool is used to send multiple consecutive packets between two connected Bluetooth devices in order to study how the transmission latency varies with the increase of the distance between said devices in corridor and room configurations. Packets of two different sizes, 44 bytes and 200 bytes, are chosen for the transmission experiments. Experimental results with the use of power banks are also obtained.

canonical_title: UIP: Unified University Information System for Prospective Students on Mobile Devices
abstract: In this project, we present you an Unified University Information System for Prospective Students on Mobile Devices (UIP) that will be used by prospective student and staff or program concealer. UIP have 3 main features are program recommendation, chat and apply.

Online sellers who advertise on social media must repost the same advertisement on each platform one by one, which divides their time and effort. The team designed JustOne, a mobile application for iOS that shares one advertisement post to Instagram, Facebook and Line at once. The report cites market research that 44 percent of local businesses in Thailand depend on promoting their businesses on social media. The app is planned as a free download on the Apple App Store with banner ads for free users. Premium features add customer chat via Line and a point of sale system with order history and printable shipment labels.

The manual senior project procedure at the faculty causes duplicated group lists, weak matching between students and advisors, and heavy paperwork. The team built a website, the VMS Senior Project System, where science and technology students form groups, select up to five topics and set priorities. Lecturers post and manage topics, rank student groups, set committees, download submitted documents and score projects. An administrator runs a matching algorithm that assigns topics, sets deadlines, maintains a repository of past reports and sends email notifications. The system was developed with PHP, HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript, uses MySQL on Apache with XAMPP, and verifies users through the university LDAP Active Directory.

abstract: This project is aimed at developing a scheduler for group meetings. This is a web based tool. Any managers can call for a meeting and send the details coordinates of the meeting (location, date, time etc.) to all invitees. This is useful for a small office, school or a department. Facility to book room and editing meeting points are also available. Room reservation system can be a very helpful system within companies or organizations. It provides services such as reserving a room for a meeting or a conference within a few minutes and can remind the participants about the meeting or conference. Furthermore, it can also reply back to the organizer who will be available or on that day or who will not be able to attend to the meeting.
